messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> service: inference-sharedpool-queue | severity: P1 | alert: 'Queue depth > 10k (5m) and processing lag > 30s' | link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345
ellen: acked. I'm on it. taking lead for mitigation. tagging @raj and @mike for infra ops.
raj: looking at metrics now — it looks like autoscaler attempted to add nodes but node provisioning stalled. cloud-api errors: RateLimitExceeded for scale-up requests.
mike: confirmed. kubernetes shows pods pending: 420 pending on nodeAffinity:shared-pool. Autoscaler logs show 409 conflicts then retries.
sara: customer-impact note: several customer requests timing out (>30s) from EU region, ~18% error spike on embeddings endpoint. CS already received 3 tickets.
ellen: okay, manual mitigation plan: 1) try emergency manual scale to alternate nodegroup 2) drain leaderless queues into fallback worker group 3) notify PD rotation and handoff if we need multi-team.
mike: to try manual scale — running command: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize shared-pool-group --size 25 --region europe-west1```
raj: while that runs, we should also open a temporary dedicated pool fallback: ```kubectl apply -f fallback-dedicated-pool.yaml --namespace inference``` — it will spin up smaller instance types but bypass sharedpool quota.
opsbot: Started task: create fallback-dedicated-pool job (job id jf-887)
incident-bot: PagerDuty: user ellen acknowledged the incident
e incident-bot: (system) Note: autoscaler attempted 6 API calls in last 2m, 4 failed with RateLimitExceeded
ellen: mike, what's the ETA on the resize?
mike: resize started, cloud reports requests accepted but API is throttling — estimate 4-6m if throttle eases, can try exponential backoff and requeue.
raj: fallback pool create is queued. PodSpec patch applied to point a subset of replicas to fallback (scaledown non-critical routes).
sara: quick customer triage: we're seeing errors mostly from long-sequence generation jobs (embeddings and rerank). Short chat requests less affected but latency up. tagging @support.
ellen: good. I'm going to escalate to platform team if we don't have nodes in 10m. @pagerduty please escalate to platform infra rotation if not resolved.
pagerduty: Escalation rule trigger: routing to platform-infra on-call in 8 minutes unless incident status changes.
mike: manual workaround applied: bumped priority for pending pods to schedule on existing spare nodes (best-effort), ~120 pods got scheduled. That lowered immediate queue by ~650.
raj: fallback pool nodes are coming up: 8/12 ready. queue drain rate improved to ~220 req/s from 80 req/s.
opsbot: Fallback pool autoscaler active (min 4, max 40)
sara: customer impact reduced: error spike down to 6% and tail latency dropping. still seeing some 502s on long requests.
ellen: update for PD notes: cause = cloud control-plane rate-limiting of the sharedpool nodegroup scale-up requests leading to autoscaler retries and provisioning stall. mitigation = create fallback dedicated pool + manual priority bump + requeue backoff.
mike: cloud support ticket opened (CS-9981) with request id 0xA1B2C3. They acknowledged throttle windows in that region due to maintenance.
raj: ops follow-up: make autoscaler tolerate transient 429/RateLimit by increasing retry-window and widen allowed nodegroups for fallback.
ellen: handing off to next on-call at +35m. @raj will stay for postmortem. I'll file incident ticket and RCA.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident status changed to 'acknowledged' by ellen.
opsbot: Mitigation actions completed: fallback pool stable, queue draining. Current queue depth: 1.2k.
sara: I'm telling CS to update customers: incident is mitigated but still monitoring.
ellen: final note: root cause hypothesis: sharedpool scale attempts hit provider rate-limit during regional maintenance window; autoscaler didn't failover fast enough to alternate groups. Action items: (1) autoscaler retry/backoff tuning (2) allow autoscaler to target alternate nodegroups earlier (3) add metric + alert for node provision rate-limits.
mike: will draft kube patch and autoscaler config change.
raj: I'll own the follow-up ticket and run a drill to reproduce with controlled rate-limiting.
ellen: thanks everyone. handing off to @raj for the next hour. closing PD once metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
